summary: Rare Earths Americas, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, FRE US, exercised an option to acquire a mining lease with Weyerhaeuser, paying $375,000 cash and 165,153 shares. This is a routine asset acquisition, not a special situation. The filing discloses material agreement entry, lease terms, and exhibits. No special-situation category applies as this is an ordinary business transaction.
